title: 'Spider-Man: Brand New Day' is coming to Prime Video October 6. Here's how to watch.
summary: From Tom Holland, Andrew Garfield, and Tobey Maguire to the animated films and series, you can buy or rent the full ‘Spider-Man’ catalog on Prime Video.
body_markdown:
---


## Key takeaways


- Spider-Man: Brand New Day


will be available to buy or rent on Prime Video starting October 6.


- Every live-action and animated


Spider-Man


film is also available to buy or rent.


- Prime Video also offers


Spider-Man


series including


“Spider-Man Noir”


and


Marvel's Spider-Man


.


---


[Spider-Man: Brand New Day](https://www.amazon.com/gp/video/detail/B0H8P8XGBC?ref_=atv_dp_share_cu_r)


comes home October 6. Preorder the latest chapter in the franchise to watch on Prime Video, where it will be available to buy or rent.


The newest installment joins a massive lineup of


[Spider-Man](https://www.amazon.com/spiderman-Prime-Video-Movies-TV/s?k=spiderman&rh=n%3A2858778011) films and series already available on


[Prime Video](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/entertainment/what-you-need-to-know-about-prime-video) , spanning more than two decades of web-slinging action.


Whether you're a fan of Tobey Maguire's original trilogy, Andrew Garfield's


The Amazing Spider-Man


films, the 2018 Oscar-winning animated


Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse


, or want to catch up on Tom Holland's adventures, Prime Video has the full


Spider-Man


collection available to buy or rent on Prime Video.


['Reacher' renewed for Season 6 after record-breaking Season 4](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/entertainment/prime-video-reacher-how-to-watch)


The global hit action series will get a sixth season as Season 4 reached 66 million viewers in its first 28 days and 200 million viewers worldwide.


Here's your guide to streaming every


Spider-Man


title on


[Prime Video](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/tag/prime-video) .


## How to stream 'Spider-Man: Brand New Day' on Prime Video


Spider-Man: Brand New Day


will be available to buy or rent on Prime Video starting October 6 for an additional cost. You can preorder the film now.


Prime Video is included with an


[Amazon Prime membership](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/retail/amazon-prime-benefits) , which costs $14.99 a month or $139 a year. Discounted memberships are also available for


[young adults](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/retail/amazon-prime-for-young-adults) and


[qualifying government assistance](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/retail/amazon-prime-access-discounted-membership) recipients at 50% off. Check your local Amazon website for pricing in your region.


You don't need a


[Prime membership](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/retail/how-to-sign-up-for-a-prime-membership) to buy or rent movies on Prime Video, but you can try Prime for free with a


[30-day trial](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/retail/amazon-prime-free-trial) .


## Which ‘Spider-Man' movies are on Prime Video?


Every live-action and animated


Spider-Man


film is available to buy or rent on Prime Video.


You can also buy a four-movie bundle with all the Tom Holland movies or a nine-movie bundle that includes the original


Spider-Man


trilogy starring Tobey Maguire,


The Amazing Spider-Man


films starring Andrew Garfield, and


Spider-Man: Homecoming


,


Spider-Man: Far From Hom


e,


Spider-Man: No Way Home


, and


Spider-Man: Brand New Day


starring Tom Holland.


Here's the full lineup.


[Everything to know about the 'Fourth Wing' series coming to Prime Video](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/entertainment/fourth-wing-series-prime-video)


Amazon MGM Studios is developing a series adaptation of the 'New York Times' best-selling fantasy novels by Rebecca Yarros.


## Tom Holland era


### 'Spider-Man: Brand New Day' (2026)


A powerful change in Peter may be the only thing that can stop a shocking new threat to the city.


Cast:


Tom Holland, Zendaya, Sadie Sink, Jacob Batalon, Jon Bernthal, Tramell Tillman, and Mark Ruffalo


[Available to buy or rent on Prime Video starting October 6](https://www.amazon.com/gp/video/detail/B0H8PJM68W?ref_=atv_sr_fle_c_sr62ef6f_1_1_1&qid=1790088623758&pageTypeIdSource=ASIN&pageTypeId=B0H8PLKHM6&sr=1-1)


### 'Spider-Man: No Way Home' (2021)


For the first time in the cinematic history of


Spider-Man


, our friendly neighborhood hero is unmasked and no longer able to separate his normal life from the high stakes of being a superhero. When he asks for help from Doctor Strange, the stakes become even more dangerous, forcing him to discover what it truly means to be Spider-Man.


Cast


: Tom Holland, Zendaya, Benedict Cumberbatch, Jacob Batalon, and Jon Favreau, with Marisa Tomei


[Available to buy or rent on Prime Video](https://www.amazon.com/gp/video/detail/B0B5NZN77V?ref_=atv_dp_amz_c_pZqpc5_1_1)


### 'Spider-Man: Far From Home' (2019)


Following the events of


Avengers: Endgame


, Spider-Man must step up to take on new threats in a world that has changed forever.


Cast:


Tom Holland, Samuel L. Jackson, Zendaya, Cobie Smulders, Jon Favreau, JB Smoove, Jacob Batalon, and Martin Starr, with Marisa Tomei and Jake Gyllenhaal


[Available to buy or rent on Prime Video](https://www.amazon.com/gp/video/detail/B07TP5M5TB?ref_=atv_dp_amz_c_pZqpc5_2_1)


### 'Spider-Man: Homecoming' (2017)


A young Peter Parker/Spider-Man, who made his sensational debut in


Captain America: Civil War


, begins to navigate his newfound identity as the web-slinging superhero.


Cast:


Tom Holland, Michael Keaton, Jon Favreau, Zendaya, Donald Glover, and Tyne Daly with Marisa Tomei and Robert Downey Jr.


[Available to buy or rent on Prime Video](https://www.amazon.com/gp/video/detail/B073HKJ1KZ?ref_=atv_dp_amz_c_pZqpc5_2_2)


### Andrew Garfield era


### 'The Amazing Spider-Man' (2012)


Peter Parker investigates his parents' disappearance while discovering his own powers and facing a dangerous new threat.


Cast:


Andrew Garfield, Emma Stone, Rhys Ifans, Denis Leary, Campbell Scott, and Irrfan Khan with Martin Sheen and Sally Field


[Available to buy or rent on Prime Video](https://www.amazon.com/gp/video/detail/B00BRAEGXY?ref_=atv_dp_amz_c_yxuuUK_3_4)


### 'The Amazing Spider-Man 2' (2014)


Peter Parker confronts a powerful new enemy named Electro while uncovering deeper secrets about his past.


Cast:


Andrew Garfield, Emma Stone, Jamie Foxx, Dane DeHaan, Sally Field, Paul Giamatti, B.J. Novak, Felicity Jones, Campbell Scott


[Available to buy or rent on Prime Video](https://www.amazon.com/gp/video/detail/B00JPNZMG0?ref_=atv_dp_amz_c_yxuuUK_2_5)


[How to watch "Spider-Noir," streaming now on Prime Video](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/entertainment/spider-noir-nicolas-cage-prime-video)


The series is based on the Marvel comic 'Spider-Man Noir' and stars Nicolas Cage as private investigator Ben Reilly.


### Tobey Maguire era


### 'Spider-Man' (2002)


Peter Parker battles his archenemy, the Green Goblin, in the film that launched the modern superhero movie era.


Cast:


Tobey Maguire, Kirsten Dunst, James Franco, Alfred Molina, Rosemary Harris, and Donna Murphy


[Available to buy or rent on Prime Video](https://www.amazon.com/gp/video/detail/B00D0U0HV4?ref_=atv_dp_amz_c_yxuuUK_2_1)


### 'Spider-Man 2' (2004)


Peter Parker faces off against a brilliant scientist with mechanical tentacles in this critically acclaimed sequel.


Cast:


Tobey Maguire, Alfred Molina, Kirsten Dunst, Donna Murphy, Rosemary Harris, James Franco


[Available to buy or rent on Prime Video](https://www.amazon.com/gp/video/detail/B00C1LE2HS?ref_=atv_dp_amz_c_yxuuUK_2_1)


### 'Spider-Man 3' (2007)


A strange black entity from another world bonds with Peter Parker and causes inner turmoil as he contends with new villains, temptations, and revenge.


Cast:


Tobey Maguire, Kirsten Dunst, James Franco, Thomas Haden Church, Topher Grace, Bryce Dallas Howard, James Cromwell, Rosemary Harris, and J.K. Simmons


[Available to buy or rent on Prime Video](https://www.amazon.com/gp/video/detail/B0GMNMGM19?ref_=atv_dp_amz_c_pZqpc5_1_2)


## Animated ‘Spider-Man’ films


### 'Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse' (2018)


This Oscar-winning animated film introduces Brooklyn teen Miles Morales and the limitless possibilities of the Spider-Verse, where more than one person can wear the mask.


Cast:


Shameik Moore, Jake Johnson, Hailee Steinfeld, Mahershala Ali, Brian Tyree Henry, Lily Tomlin, Luna Lauren Velez, Zoë Kravitz, and John Mulaney with Nicolas Cage, Kathryn Hahn, and Liev Schreiber


[Available to buy on Prime Video](https://www.amazon.com/gp/video/detail/B07L8QG732?ref_=atv_dp_amz_c_yxuuUK_2_8)


### 'Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse' (2023)


Miles Morales returns for the next chapter of this Oscar-nominated saga, where he must redefine what it means to be a hero after finding himself pitted against a team of Spider-People charged with protecting the Multiverse's very existence.


Cast:


Shameik Moore, Hailee Steinfeld, Brian Tyree Henry, Luna Lauren Velez, Jake Johnson, Jason Schwartzman, Issa Rae, and Karan Soni, with Daniel Kaluuya, Mahershala Ali, and Oscar Isaac


[Available to buy or rent on Prime Video](https://www.amazon.com/gp/video/detail/B0GNRPCVYD?ref_=atv_dp_amz_c_nBbexy_2_1)


## Which 'Spider-Man' series are on Prime Video?


Photo by Courtesy of Prime


In addition to the films, Prime Video also offers several


Spider-Man


series:


- [“Spider-Man Noir”](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/entertainment/spider-noir-nicolas-cage-prime-video)


(available exclusively on Prime Video)


- [Marvel's Ultimate Spider-Man: Web Warriors](https://www.amazon.com/gp/video/detail/B0F6WTLTM6?ref_=atv_dp_amz_c_yxuuUK_2_4)


(available to buy)


- [Marvel's Spider-Man](https://www.amazon.com/gp/video/detail/B0F5MKCMHT?ref_=atv_sr_fle_c_srfd6f9a_4_1_2&qid=1790089200315&pageTypeIdSource=ASIN&pageTypeId=B0F5MMSDFV&sr=1-2) (available to buy)


- [Spectacular Spider-Man](https://www.amazon.com/gp/video/detail/B00C0YDK4W?pageTypeIdSource=ASIN&qid=1790089179395&sr=1-1&pageTypeId=B01904H3AG&ref_=atv_sr_fle_c_sr9f90f0_1_1_1) (available to buy)


- [Spidey and His Amazing Friends](https://www.amazon.com/gp/video/detail/B09CB2LQ3M?qid=1790089217772&pageTypeId=B09C9XJXH4&pageTypeIdSource=ASIN&ref_=atv_sr_fle_c_srfd6f9a_3_1_1&sr=1-1) (available to buy)


## What else can I watch on Prime Video?


Prime Video is home to a huge catalog of other movies, series, live sports, and more across multiple genres. This includes


[Amazon MGM Studios-produced](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/tag/mgm) content like


[The Boys](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/entertainment/the-boys-renewed-season-5-prime-video) ,


[The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/entertainment/lord-of-the-rings-the-rings-of-power-season-2) ,


[Fallout](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/entertainment/fallout-season-2-season-3-prime-video) , and


[Reacher](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/entertainment/prime-video-reacher-how-to-watch) .


All customers, regardless of whether they have a Prime membership or not, can


[access programming through subscriptions](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/entertainment/what-are-prime-video-channels) on Prime Video such as Paramount+,


[MGM+](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/entertainment/everything-you-need-to-know-about-mgm-plus) ,


[Apple TV](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/entertainment/apple-tv-shows-amazon-prime-video-subscription) ,


[HBO Max](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/entertainment/hbo-max-on-prime-video-channels) ,


[Peacock](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/entertainment/peacock-shows-movies-prime-video-subscription) ,


[FOX One](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/entertainment/fox-one-news-sports-entertainment-prime-video-subscription) , and


[Crunchyroll](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/entertainment/crunchyroll-anime-subscription-amazon-prime-video) , as well as more than 900 free ad-supported streaming television (FAST) channels, rent or buy titles, and enjoy even more content for free with ads.

[top 10 Original films and series on Prime Video](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/entertainment/prime-video-top-10-movies-shows) .
